title: Face Sculpt #247 · 한국 20대 · 섹시한 · 바비 인형(금발) · 유형 고유 메이크업 · P25 · 귀 철 추 · 푸른 시간대 호숫가
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Western woman, mid 20s, with a Barbie-pink glam look pushed to its extreme — fair skin with real visible pores and a soft rosy blush high on the apple cheeks, long, voluminous, glossy platinum-blonde waves with a soft fringe falling past her shoulders. Her eyes are gigantic: perfectly round, very wide-set, extra-large eyes with a huge visible iris, vivid sky-blue big-iris contact lenses that make the iris look enormous, both eyes exactly the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated, with a darker limbal ring and a round natural pupil, bright real catchlights and genuine depth, framed by extremely long, thick, dramatically curled false lashes top and bottom and high, softly arched eyebrows. Her lips are extremely plump: huge, round, voluptuous, high-volume lips in glossy baby-pink gloss, projecting visibly forward from her face, with a very pronounced cupid's bow and a full, pillowy lower lip, softly closed in a sweet faint smile. A tiny, perfectly straight nose with a delicate upturned tip, high rounded apple cheeks, and a small soft pointed chin. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain and a soft sheen of natural oils, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Every enhanced feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque. Her mouth is slightly open, her lips parted just enough in a confident half-smile to clearly show her upper front teeth, which are covered in polished gold grillz, each tooth capped in shining gold (this overrides the lips pressed or closed in her expression).

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about seventeen in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; on each ear, three separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below another with a clear gap of bare skin between each, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; two small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; two small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. Fine chains link the pieces: from the upper ear hoop on each side a delicate chain swags across the cheek to the ring around the nostril wing on the same side, passing well below the eye and clear of the lips, and one more fine chain hangs in a soft curve under the jaw from one ear to the other; the chains are thin enough that every piece and her whole face stay clearly visible. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. Stickers: five tiny glow-in-the-dark heart and star stickers are scattered flat on the skin of the lower cheeks and the jawline below the cheekbone studs, clear of the piercings, the eyes and the lips. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of these three iron rings, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly nine separate massive solid weights, each of a different shape: on the left ear a solid rough cube-shaped block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a small solid kettlebell with a thick short handle on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a short thick solid cylinder stump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid squat hammer head block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a chunky solid hexagonal block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid pyramid-shaped lump with a wide base on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough boulder-like lump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cannonball on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a thick solid disc like a weight plate on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links; on the right ear a solid rough boulder-like lump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cube-shaped block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a small solid kettlebell with a thick short handle on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid pyramid-shaped lump with a wide base on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a short thick solid cylinder stump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cannonball on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a chunky solid hexagonal block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid squat hammer head block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid thick rectangular ingot block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links. On each ear the three iron rings share the weights between them in uneven numbers, each ring carrying its own column of weights, hanging side by side on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is an enormous, dense, completely solid, squat, blunt lump of rough black cast iron, at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, with no thin parts, no arms and no hollow parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because the load is shared between three openings, the weight pulls each earlobe down only very slightly into a soft, healthy loop of skin, a barely noticeable natural droop that is just enough to show the weights are heavy; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real blackened steel set with small clear diamonds, one-colour, restrained, while the hanging weights are always black cast iron, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: The background is a lakeside at blue hour, a blurred dark navy lake and distant hills under a deep indigo sky, out of focus with a shallow depth of field, with no objects and no people in the background, and the background is darker and softer than her face so that her face and the metal are the brightest, sharpest part of the image. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from her skin tone, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
